banned_patterns.pattern: (?is)the relevant facts are pleaded in paragraphs?\s+\d+\s*[-–—]\s*\d+

rubric.description: Each officer unit identifies its own incorporated factual paragraphs instead of relying on omnibus incorporation or a broad paragraph range.
Each officer unit states the facts known to that officer at the challenged seizure point and directly applies those facts to entry, notice, probable cause, and arguable probable cause.
The later report and charging decision have an express limited later function and do not enter either officer's earlier knowledge set.
Each officer's personal causal stage and resulting loss of liberty are stated separately.
Each officer unit applies QI prong one and QI prong two, including conduct-specific fair warning from the approved pre-event authority.
